zh: 新增智能体「需要你」审批收件箱与多用户跨端通知：汇总当前账号下所有待审批操作与多会话产物隔离，支持按设定超时延迟推送至 WeLink 助理、微信及 welink-cli，在群聊或私聊中回复「批准/拒绝 验证码」即可远程完成结算。
多用户会话排序、侧边栏精简与移动端离线缓存升级：Web 端支持置顶对话仅纵向拖拽排序并按用户独立持久化、精简侧边栏冗余入口；iOS / Android 端新增按账号隔离的本地会话缓存与历史增量同步，修复 iOS 端 Keychain 凭据读取触发 errSecParam (-50) 导致登录后秒退及主题切换闪跳问题。
工具权限展示对齐、Excel 线性解析与 AI 导入填表修复：智能体工具配置面板支持多用户团队权限对齐；修复 read_document / query_data 及源码解析器在万行以上 Excel 表格下的 O(R²·C²) 卡死问题；修复导入自定义 HTML 工具时未对 Gemini 数组包装及别名 JSON 解包导致的 AI 自动填表失败。
en: Added the cross-conversation 'Needs You' agent approval inbox with per-user artifact isolation, delayed notifications (WeLink bot, WeChat, and welink-cli), and direct chat replies ('approve/deny <code>') to settle pending actions remotely.

Multi-user conversation sorting, streamlined sidebar, and mobile offline cache isolation: Web pinned chats now support vertical drag-to-reorder persistence per user; iOS and Android add account-scoped local conversation caches, incremental sync, and fixes for iOS Keychain errSecParam (-50) instant session expiry and theme flicker.

Tool permission UI alignment, linear Excel parsing, and AI import metadata fixes: refined team access controls in agent tool settings, resolved O(R²·C²) ExcelJS column-getter stalls in read_document/query_data and sheet parsers, and unwrapped array-wrapped and aliased JSON responses from Gemini during custom HTML tool metadata extraction.
